title_en: Interdimensional Portals and Hidden Bunkers — the Extreme Lengths GTA 6 Players Are Taking to Lose 6 Star Wanted Levels
summary_en: Losing six stars in GTA 6 is meant to be impossible, but players are trying everything from interdimensional portals to hidden bunkers to escape the cops.
body_en:
GTA 6 's new police system is one of the most interesting things about the game. Instead of omnipresent cops, the police have have various levels of awareness, and you can use guile and cunning to outsmart them and escape.
There are still wanted stars, which represent how much of the police force is dedicated to hunting you down, but a well-considered escape plan can get you out of most kinds of trouble. Just escape the search zone, lose line of sight, and change how you look to get away.
That is unless you cause too much carnage. If you go off the deep end and cause real mayhem, you’ll eventually reach six stars. Six stars in GTA 6 sees almost the entire map become a search zone, and the cops will never stop tracking you down, according to Rockstar. If you need a pointer, here's how to get a six-star wanted level in GTA 6 .
If you hide indoors, the army comes along with a tank. If you jump in a plane, jets are scrambled to shoot you down. If you try to escape by car, attack helicopters perform a strafing run to blow you off the road. Eventually, no matter how hard you try, you will succumb to the pressure. Six stars, it is thought, amounts to a death sentence.
But is that guaranteed? Since GTA 6 came out, players have been looking for creative ways of breaking the rule around the highest wanted level. Using clever tricks, some are exploring ways to escape a six-star police hunt and return to regular gameplay — which should technically only be possible two ways: you die or get busted.
Warning! GTA 6 spoilers follow.
One player used a series of secret bunkers that you can open up to get access to a GTA 6 tank . Here’s the clip:
⭐️ LE PREMIER JOUEUR AU MONDE A RÉUSSIR À SEMER LES 6 ETOILES SUR GTA 6 !
Il est allé dans un sous sol rempli de bunkers pour réussir à semer la police. https://t.co/8Q0nd27eOn
Another player in the comments said they managed to replicate this by swimming. “Bro, I actually did it yesterday. I managed to escape the 6-star wanted level,” they said . “Just keep diving underwater, and when your oxygen is almost depleted, swim back to the surface. Keep repeating this until you find a jet ski. Then ride it beyond the 6-star search area, and boom! You're free.”
Some players think the underwater cave system in Emerald Springs could be another prime candidate, since cops can’t send diving teams after you. If you head to Emerald Spring and look for signs for the Selkie Hole, there’s diving equipment you can use to explore an underground cave network.
Another player went to more extreme lengths to avoid the cops. After completing the majority of the long Vice City Easter egg in GTA 6 , they left the world through a portal back to the ‘80s. When they came back to present-day Leonida, the cops didn’t care about them or their Tommy Vercetti shirt anymore. Here’s that clip:
世界初？GTA6で手配度6から逃げきることに成功しました https://t.co/0g7pSPJ6UU
“The cops in GTA are so overpowered that you can't escape them unless you go to another world,” said one commenter . “Now THAT'S how you escape the six star wanted level. That’s gangsta,” said another .
One fan also claimed to have escaped six stars by swimming into an underwater research station. Unfortunately, the video doesn’t actually show the six stars vanishing, but I guess they technically escaped, as long as they stay there forever.
6 STARS ESCAPE Underwater Research Facility IN GTA 6 (is coded if you get 6 stars they will recognize you no matter what, testes same thing with 5 stars and it worked) https://t.co/jfZZMzdvs4
It’ll be interesting to see if any new strategies formulate around losing six stars, although getting the full six isn’t something that generally happens by accident in ordinary gameplay. You have to cause a lot of carnage to bring the full weight of Leonida’s police down on your head.
